practice.foundation[6]: The booklet states this property at Book 2 lines 493–500 but does not ask students to explain it. This explanatory task is an off-booklet type; its solution should also allow a graph to touch the axis rather than only cross it.

practice.development[0]: The supplied source asks to read cubic zeroes from a graph, not solve a cubic rule for zeroes. Cubic intercept calculation inside a sketching solution does not establish this question type.
